avSummary: Ananias (of Damascus) 6, Ananias (of Jerusalem) 3, Ananias (high priest) 2
definition:
Ananias = "whom Jehovah has graciously given"

 1) a certain Christian at Jerusalem, the husband of Sapphira #Ac 5:1-6
 2) a Christian at Damascus #Ac 9:10-18
 3) a son of Nedebaeus, and high priest of the Jews c. A.D.
    47-59. In the year 66, he was slain by the Sacarii. #Ac 23:2
